title: Hard Resurrection
description: Mod that allows you to resurrect fallen player in hardcore mod
body:
Hard Resurrection is a NeoForge magic gameplay mod that adds a mysterious resurrection shrine, soul rituals, and a bound spirit book to Minecraft.
Players can find the ancient shrine around the world spawn and use rare items to bind the name of a fallen friend into the book. Through a dangerous ritual at the shrine’s lectern, you can call their soul back and give them one more chance at life – at a cost.
The mod is designed to feel vanilla‑friendly: no flashy HUDs, just structures, items, and mechanics that fit naturally into survival worlds, SMP servers, and story‑driven worlds.
